# Historical provenance

ArbolFluent's initial application snapshot was generated from the `Ruvents.Solution`
template version 1.2.0 at source commit
`7034699d7a13d017564264fb5b0e3d71139c818d`.

Acceptance results recorded in that template describe the Ruvents starter. They
do not describe ArbolFluent, and they do not describe applications generated from
`ArbolFluent.Templates`. No separate ArbolFluent historical acceptance matrix is
recorded here.

Each candidate `ArbolFluent.Templates` package must be validated by
`scripts/Test-Template.ps1` before installation. That receipt describes the exact
package that was tested; see [Template maintenance](README.md).
